Leah (Product): proposing a new rollout pattern for customer-driven features: 'anchor-and-peak'. idea: anchor small baseline to validate stability, then short, instrumented peak windows to surface rare regressions under load. goal is faster launches for prioritized customers without long global ramps.

Diego (Eng): curious about orchestration. what's the stage flow?

Leah (Product): flow sketch:
1) anchor (0.5% stable cohort, baseline routing) — smoke + shadowing for 2h
2) peak window (5% for 30m windows at predictable times, repeated 3x across days) — active A/B with holdback
3) soak (20% regional for 24h)
4) full (100%)
fallback: immediate steer to anchor variant plus token-throttling if p95 > threshold.

Ritika (SRE): need firm SLO gates for each stage. propose:
- anchor: p95 delta <= +30ms, error-rate increase < 0.2% over baseline (5m rolling)
- peak: p95 delta <= +60ms, 5xx rate < 0.5% and no tenant-level circuit trips
- soak: sustained error < 0.2% and no more than 3 incidents in 12h
if gate fails, auto-backoff to previous stage and trigger page.

Hannah (Platform): for peak windows we should schedule them during low-cost billing windows? also need a deterministic routing precedence: experiment > routing-stable > fallback. i'll add routing precedence to tenant-mapper.

Diego (Eng): we need integrated experiment metrics: completion-rate, latency, token-cost-per-completion, and a quality delta computed from live-eval harness (sampled). quality thresholds: no drop >0.7 points on 5k live-sampled prompts. will implement sampling + compare to holdback.

Marco (CS): for customers asking early access, we require opt-in doc + opt-in cohort mapping. we should exclude any tenant with a custom SLA or on Dedicated until soak passes. also CS wants a pre-launch customer brief template.

Ritika (SRE): ops protections: per-tenant qps cap, per-region aggregate cap, and noisy-neighbor isolation. add circuit-breaker rule: if a tenant hits 3 times the median 5xx rate for 10m, we auto-exclude them from the experiment (not global rollback).

Hannah (Platform): feature-flag shape suggestion (keeps it small and consistent):
```json
{
  "flag": "anchor_and_peak_v1",
  "phases": [
    {"id":"anchor","pct":0.5,"mode":"shadow+route"},
    {"id":"peak","pct":5,"mode":"ab","windows":["09:00-09:30","16:00-16:30"]},
    {"id":"soak","pct":20,"mode":"route","regions":["na","eu"]},
    {"id":"full","pct":100,"mode":"route"}
  ],
  "holdback":"anchor_variant",
  "fallback":"anchor_variant",
  "page_on":"gate_fail"
}
```
Diego (Eng): include an experiment id header so we can join traces across systems. also, ensure KV-cache keying uses stable prefix to avoid cache divergence between variants.

Leah (Product): launch acceptance checklist for a customer-driven ask:
- [ ] run 5k live-sampled prompts + pass quality gate
- [ ] smoke run on anchor + shadowing enabled
- [ ] peak windows scheduled and telemetry hooks wired
- [ ] alerts & dashboard ready: experiment_p95_delta, experiment_5xx_rate, experiment_quality_delta
- [ ] opt-in contract signed (if required)
- [ ] CS notified and pre-launch brief sent to customer

Marco (CS): i'll prep the brief template and an opt-in note.

Ritika (SRE): i'll create the alert rules and a one-page runbook: auto-backoff steps + how to exclude a tenant from experiment.

deploy-bot: experiment created: https://infra.redwood/experiments/1751112222-anchor_and_peak_v1 — owners: Leah, Diego, Ritika.

Leah (Product): final asks: keep peak windows short and repeated to catch transient regressions; don't use them during major infra change windows. target alpha next Tue 11:00 PT if eng + ops are clear. anything blocking?

Diego (Eng): will open PR for routing precedence + experiment header today.

Hannah (Platform): i'll wire tenant mapping and reserve a small Dedicated pool for opt-ins.

Ritika (SRE): no blocks. I'll schedule a tabletop with oncall tomorrow.

Leah (Product): ok locking in Tue 11:00 PT for alpha. thanks everyone. :rocket:
